Experience the quiet beauty of Slovenia by bike in this immersive preview featuring rolling alpine meadows, traditional shepherd huts, and peaceful mountain valleys. From gentle gravel roads to wide-open landscapes, this journey captures the rhythm, freedom, and restorative calm of biking through Slovenia’s countryside. 🌿 This is a preview of a longer cycling and nature film. 🎬 Watch the full-length, commercial-free experience on NatureStream.tv, with access to over 100 hours of immersive 4K nature journeys from around the world. ✨ What you’ll see in this preview:
Scenic countryside cycling in Slovenia Alpine meadows, valleys, and mountain backdrops Peaceful, slow-travel visuals designed for relaxation and inspiration

programme.title: Holiday Heart
programme.desc: After losing his police officer lover, Christian drag queen Holiday Heart (Ving Rhames) meets 12-year-old Niki (Jessika Quynn Reynolds) and her drug-addicted mother, Wanda (Alfre Woodard). Heart finds relief from heartache and a renewed sense of purpose when he steps in as a father figure to Niki and welcomes the two women into his life. But when Wanda becomes romantically involved with her drug dealer, Silas, it may endanger Niki and threaten to destroy the makeshift family.

programme.title: Leprechaun in the Hood
programme.desc: When aspiring hip-hop performers Butch (Red Grant), Postmaster P. (Anthony Montgomery) and Stray Bullet (Rashaan Nall) cross record producer Mack Daddy (Ice-T), their grudge against him leads to their own peril. After they break into Mack Daddy's home and swipe an ancient medallion from a grotesque statue, the evil Leprechaun (Warwick Davis) is freed from his magical prison. Soon the sinister little man is on the trail of Butch, Postmaster P. and Stray Bullet, along with Mack Daddy himself.

programme.title: Leprechaun: Back 2 tha Hood
programme.desc: City hairdresser Emily Woodrow (Tangi Miller) finds the answer to her financial problems when she stumbles upon a chest brimming with gold. Although she and her friends quickly go from rags to riches, they discover that the gold belongs to someone else: an evil leprechaun (Warwick Davis) who has returned from hell to claim his treasure. Speaking in riddles and rhymes, the demon stalks his victims with ruthless determination -- and scores some excellent pot along the way.

programme.title: Traffik
programme.desc: Brea and John embark on a romantic weekend getaway to an isolated estate in the mountains. They are pleasantly surprised when two of their friends, Darren and Malia, also show up unexpectedly. Their plans for fun soon give way to terror when members of a violent biker gang invade the peaceful countryside. Banded together, they now find themselves in a fight for their lives as their assailants will stop at nothing to protect their secrets from the outside world.

programme.title: Iron Eagle on the Attack
programme.desc: Retired from the Air Force, Chappy Sinclair (Lou Gossett Jr.) now runs a private flight school that happens to cater to misfits and juvenile offenders. Desperate to instill discipline, Chappy hires as an instructor his former protégé, Doug Masters (Jason Cadieux), who had previously been shot down by the Soviets. During training, Doug and the youths encounter drug dealers, toxic chemicals and an insidious conspiracy that threatens to ignite a global war.

programme.title: Fifty Shades of Black
programme.desc: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," Hannah Steele interviews entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) for her roommate's school newspaper. The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work.

programme.title: Set Up
programme.desc: With help from a gangster, a betrayed man (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) seeks revenge for a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: A New Kind of Woman
programme.desc: Interpersonal relationships are quickly pushed to the edge as a pompous husband, Brian, and his battered wife, Latavia, hold a brunch with unexpected consequences. When their invited guests, Todd and Glenda arrive, inhibitions are lowered, and lingering hostile and dark secrets are revealed. Sex, relationships, class, and revenge are explored over a bit too much wine.

programme.title: Apple Mortgage Cake
programme.desc: To avoid losing her home to foreclosure, single mother Angela Logan (Kimberly Elise) tries to bake and sell 100 apple cakes in 10 days.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Chain of Command
programme.desc: James Webster returns from duty to find his brother murdered. Now, as he pursues the perpetrators and follows the chain, he discovers a conspiracy that runs deep within the government.

programme.title: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In 72 hours a meteor will collide with Earth and annihilate mankind. Singapore's government tells its citizens to let loose for once and do absolutely anything they please.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.title: Miss Dial
programme.desc: A consumer affairs rep in a rocky relationship spends her day calling random people, looking for new connections. She unexpectedly meets someone on the phone that might just change everything, including her heart.

programme.title: The Rhythm
programme.desc: Robert transforms a group of roller skaters into a championship-caliber ice-hockey team by harnessing their natural talent and passion, but they must confront racism and discrimination in the predominantly white world of the sport.

programme.title: Five Star
programme.desc: A longtime gang member (James 'Primo' Grant) shows a fast-taking teen (John Diaz) how to operate on the mean streets of Brooklyn, N.Y.

programme.title: From the Rough
programme.desc: Catana Starks becomes the first woman to coach a collegiate men's golf team and subsequently guides her misfit players to an all-time-record championship season.

programme.title: Out on Parole
programme.desc: An ex-con may miss a crucial meeting with his parole officer if he enters a low-rider contest to save his mother's home.

programme.title: Meet the Blacks
programme.desc: When some unexpected money comes his way, Carl Black moves his family from cold and windy Chicago to bright and sunny Beverly Hills, Calif. As the Blacks settle into their beautiful new home, they start to notice some strange behavior in the neighborhood. Nighttime is approaching, and President El bama announces that the annual purge is about to begin. Carl and his loved ones must now endure a 12-hour period of lawlessness before they can enjoy life once again.

programme.title: Stan Helsing
programme.desc: Stan (Steve Howey), a slacker video store clerk, his sexy girlfriend, best friend and an exotic dancer take a detour into a town cursed by the biggest monsters in movie history.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Alex returns from Argentina and his reunion with Stevie begins blissfully. Moira has helped her set up a romantic picnic spot for their first supper together since the honeymoon.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tayler and Patrick's happy domesticity is disrupted when Tayler's mother, Jane, returns. Jane wants to set the record straight with her daughter about why she left, but Tayler is wary. Meanwhile, baby Xander has not smiled yet, and it's worrying Stevie immensely.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Grace, Jaz, Marcus, and Frank head off to the city to confront the Minister responsible for a dam proposal that will take away their water. Meanwhile, Phil gives Moira a personal and surprising gift.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jaz is taken aback when Lily reveals her dad, Frank, is talking about proposing to her. Jaz needs to decide how to deal with the situation. programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Marcus has been looking for a new overseer for weeks, but given his constant clashing with Ben, neither of them can accept that Ben is right for the job. The district Yard Dog trials are fast approaching when Ben is befriended by a border collie.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After finding her horse from Europe grazing in the paddock, Jaz is surprised to discover she has been personally delivered by Mischa. The others are stunned to discover Mischa is a wealthy prince and Jaz's ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Concerned that Jaz is getting caught up in Mischa's scheme to clear her name, Grace threatens to report him to the officials if he puts Jaz at risk by going through with his plan. Moira debates telling Phil she is pregnant, and his reaction is far from what she expected.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Rumours run amok after the ball, as the town believes Steve is dating Marcus. Repercussions occur when one man, Ted Franklin, causes problems for Drovers Run and Tayler takes it upon herself to dig up gossip on him to bargain with.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Following a costly accident, Ben helps Jaz try to determine what is spooking her horse, Annie, as she hopes to use her for work on Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Grace discovers that some of the new Drovers cattle have been stolen, and Tayler poses as Ingrid's assistant after a mistake.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Ingrid's husband Paul is investigating the cattle theft, and Ingrid is scared of what he might do if he finds out about her relationship with Marcus. Meanwhile, Phil is trying to make Moira feel better and has planned a special evening.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Out of the hospital after being shot, Ingrid's husband Paul is determined to get his wife and he will not let anyone stand in his way. Ingrid is more concerned than ever for her own safety, as well as that of her friends who did their best to help her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Rehearsals are in full swing as Moira prepares to play the leading girl in Phil's musical. During the preparations, she finds out that Phil's son is getting married, but Phil isn't planning to attend the wedding, and she decides to interfere.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.desc: It's shearing time and one of the men arrives with a reputation as a killer. Tess witnesses some strange events and uncovers a secret.

programme.desc: Jealousy abounds as Claire competes in the rodeo and two men compete for Tess's affection; Becky's reputation gets her in trouble.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire buys a pen of undernourished sheep from the stock sales, leaving Tess to question her judgment.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess's confidence is shaken after she falls from her horse, forcing her to wonder whether she truly belongs at Drovers Run.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess finds out that Jack loved Claire; Meg and Claire discover more about Becky's life when she returns to the truck stop.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire must pay off a debt to Harry Ryan, who has his eye on Drovers Run. Tapped out of cash, she has no choice but to offer him her father's old mahogany desk, which is steeped in sentimental value for her and Tess.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Claire's new mare runs off with a wild stallion, Alex and Nick offer their help. Tess and Nick search for the horses on motorbikes while Alex and Claire take to the skies in a helicopter.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Just when Tess thinks she's beginning to get the hang of ranch life, the hunt for a dangerous wild boar that is threatening the livestock disrupts life and throws her skills into question.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Emotional and traumatic events of the past and present return to haunt the lives of the women of Drovers Run. The pain of dealing with loss forces each of them to find a way to deal with these life-altering events.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The youngest member of the Drovers Run family is ready to celebrate her 18th birthday in style, but no one seems very interested in helping her mark such a special occasion.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jealousies and family tensions between the Ryan brothers suddenly come to light when an innocent question by Tess re-opens a very ugly wound.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Bill Tilson decides to sell up and move to the city, Claire sees the precariousness of her own situation and it prompts her to work harder than ever to keep Drovers Run.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Theft is on everyone's mind since there are cattle duffers working in the district and a flock of Claire's sheep has gone missing.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Claire attends a seminar on artificial insemination with Alex, she leaves Tess in charge of Drovers Run. In spite of a few doubts, Claire gives her a new pair of boots to honour the occasion, and it turns out that Tess will truly have to earn them.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The sudden death of local farmer Max Martin alarms Harry prompting fears of his own mortality, and a sudden drive to defy whatever fate may have in store by pursuing a rapid expansion of his property.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After reaping good profits at the sheep sales, the girls are ready to celebrate with a night at the pub and a bit of Karaoke.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire is finding it difficult to come to terms with Tess's new found relationship with Alex. Her dream of developing a quarter horse breeding program at Drovers Run looks as if it may be close to coming true and she's using it as an excuse to push Tess away.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Alberto, a good-looking itinerant Italian, rescues Jodi from a rampant steer she falls hopelessly in love with him. At first, Meg isn't too worried as Alberto will be moving on.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess finds an old psychology textbook, she becomes obsessed with trying to figure out the real reasons for people's actions. Tess, however, is not prepared for the truths she uncovers about those around her, and also faces something she is reluctant to answer herself.

programme.desc: After a grubby day with the cattle, Tess is delighted when Simon and Briony, two old friends, show up for an unexpected visit. And they've got news, big news: they've got a lease on the café they all dreamed about and they want Tess to come back to the city with them ASAP.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.desc: Fresh pasta is an Italian family tradition passed through the generations. Today she starts with a silky pappardelle pasta dressed with pesto made from walnut, basil and parsley. She then takes the same pasta dough and shapes it into Tortelloni stuffed with spinach and ricotta, dressed with a classic marinara sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads.to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joing her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes. Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, Bread Puddign with Pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a large pot of bubbling polenta, a dish that she grew up with and loved. From that polenta, she'll bake Crostini with Mixed Mushrooms and Cheese which is a perfect starter to any meal. Her granddaughter, Julia, joins her in the kitchen to help assemble and of course, taste! She'll then prepare a Hearty Polenta Dish with Bacon and Broccoli, a perfect combination. Finally, she'll make Sweet Skillet Sausage with Mixed Grapes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia talks about pasta in her family, it's never "basta!" Today, she creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a Linguine with Swisschard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta. She then makes a simple dish of Farfalle with Swordfish, prepared with tomatoes, fresh herbs and capers. And finally, there is nothing better than Lidia's Spaghetti and Meatballs!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summertime is dinner party season, and Lidia loves to serve family style meals. Today, she'll create a summer menu fit for any celebration. The menu includes grilled skewers of Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini and Tomato Salsa, steamed summery Green Beans with Mint Pesto and Berry Tiramisu - Lidia's summer berry twist one of the most famous Italian desserts!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Skillet shrimp with asparagus features sauteed shrimp over grilled bread; skillet gratinate of pork, aubergine and zucchini; one-pot soft polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves cooking for her family and today, she shares some of her favorite recipes to make for her grandkids, including a refreshing and kid-friendly Cherry Almond Spritzer; a simple dessert of Grilled Fruit, which brings out the fruit's natural sweetness; and Pasta Salad with Green Beans, Tomatoes and Mozzarella, a great dish for buffets, picnics, and large family gatherings.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The key to a delicious meal is coaxing a lot of flavor from an ingredient, whether it is meat or vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares two ragu recipes: Lamb and Pepper Ragu: and a Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu: a heart, flavorful medley of chestnuts and mushrooms that make for a satisfying vegetarian ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple in Lidia's kitchen and she loves planning dinner parties based on seafood. Today's menu includes Swordfish Skewers with a Sweet and Sour Sauce, made with balsamic vinegar and bay leaves; and Stuffed Calamari with bread crumbs, hard-boiled eggs, grated cheese, white wine, and parsley.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia creates the ultimate heartwarming dinner table filled with dishes that deliver flavor, comfort and love in every bite. She starts with a soothing Rice and Lentil Soup topped with cheese and olive oil; Roasted Olives with Orange and Rosemary are an exciting accompaniment to any meal and Ricotta Meatloaf, a family favorite packed with cheese and topped with fresh tomato sauce and even more cheese, is the star of the show.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia as she shares holiday traditions with four families across America. From New York to San Antonio and San Francisco, celebrate Christmas, Passover, and Chinese New Year with Mo Rocca, Stanley Tucci, Ruth Reichl, and more!
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday Tables & Traditions

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's episode features a collection of the best of Italian dolce or sweets- from cookies to cake to pudding. Lidia begins this episode with Anise Cookies, then prepares a Mint Granita, a light and heavenly Angel Cake with Fresh Berries, and lastly a Rice Pudding with a Blessing, inspired by one of the convents in Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their seasons, and they know how to make delicious soups, salads and pastas with fall and winter vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares some winter garden menu ideas including a spicy Escarole and White Bean Soup, a unique and delicious Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens and a Cabbage Salad made with warm bacon dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: If there were another name for Lidia's family, it would be the gnocchi family. They love making them together AND eating them. Lidia starts with a Butternut Squash Gnocchi that is as soft as a feather and served with a velvety sage and butter sauce. Next, she prepares a Marinated Bread of Chicken Seared with Shiitake Mushrooms, Rosemary and Sage. Her sautéed earthy Brussels Sprouts are made with pepperoncino, garlic and walnuts. They are nutty AND spicy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: This episode features a "Best of Chicken" with some of Lidia's favorite dishes from the oven to the stovetop. programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has shared her love for gnocchi and passing on traditions for years, and in this episode she makes the gnocchi out of cheese.The comforting meal includes: Lentil Country Salad, Cheese Gnocchi with Butter and Sage Sauce, and Pork Pockets Stuffed with Pickles and Cheese.
programme.sub-title: Gnocchi Time Memories with the Grandkids

programme.title: America's Black Forum
programme.desc: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the borders at Longmeadow hit their stride, it's time to take stock of what's looking good and what needs replacing. Monty shares his tips on how to keep the display going all summer long. There's plenty to do on the vegetable plot too and things are looking promising in the fruit garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With the holiday season well and truly upon us, Monty shares some timely tips on how to make sure your garden doesn't suffer while you are away. But there are some gardeners that daren't leave home, as Joe Swift discovered when he met Phillip Vowles.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With one of the driest summers in many years, Monty responds to viewers' questions and has plenty of advice on how to deal with drought conditions for vegetables, fruit, flowers and containers. Carol Klein celebrates one of the most flamboyant summer shrubs, the hydrangea.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With the Wimbledon tennis championships just around the corner, Joe Swift meets the gardening team responsible for the spectacular floral displays at this world-renowned event.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty travels to two corners of the country where the challenges he faces are very different. On the south coast he is presented with a front garden ravaged by salty winds, and in Snowdonia he helps a mountainside garden.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty faces some of the most surprising plans yet - a Norwegian garden complete with waterfalls to be fashioned out of a tiny backyard in Dorset, and nothing less than a Japanese tea garden to be created out of a patch of ground in Bromley.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team tackle a vertiginous three-tiered garden. This is no simple back lawn: the garden is so steep that it rises above the roof of the house to offer fantastic views of the local forest and mountain, which the owners want to take advantage of.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The Rich brothers and Arit Anderson are on a mission to create a family garden in Horsham in Sussex for James, Charlotte and their young daughter Esmé. The trouble is, at the moment, their garden is about as exciting as a blank sheet of A4 paper.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: After a busy winter, Monty plants up pots for early colour, shows how to move a clematis and sows veg for the year ahead. Adam Frost visits Ventnor Botanic Garden on the Isle of Wight. A gardener turned a concrete slab into her dream with containers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Gardeners' World comes from the RHS Malvern Spring Festival. Adam Frost and Arit Anderson reveal the highlights of the show gardens and this year's must-have flowers and plants on display in the Floral Marquee.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: There's been a huge surge of interest in houseplants, so Frances Tophill and Nick Bailey celebrate the joys of indoor gardening from Oxford Botanic Garden. Rachel de Thame visits a nursery in Devon who specialise in growing orchids.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty shows the range of vegetables that can be easily grown in containers if you are short on space, moves ornamental grasses and sows zinnias. Nick Bailey gives us an insight into the bearded iris in Buckinghamshire.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don shows how to get the best from tomatoes planted in grow bags, Adam Frost tackles planting in a shady border, and Frances Tophill meets a couple who've created a garden inspired by their travels.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty turns his attention to the containers in the jewel garden, plants courgettes and clematis and checks up on his bees. Arit Anderson meets a woman on a mission to green up unloved and neglected outdoor spaces in west London, and Nick Bailey continues his journey through the world of the iris, this time turning his attention to Siberian and water irises.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The team head to Birmingham for one of the highlights of the horticultural calendar: the annual Gardeners' World Live event.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty shows how to prune and train the summer growth of climbing roses and makes the most of the seasonal warmth by planting perennials and sowing annuals. Frances Tophill visits a viewer's garden to give advice on how to prune unruly shrubs.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gets to work in his wildlife garden to ensure that there are plenty of plants in flower for early pollinators. Carol Klein meets Stuart Donachie who has embraced every planting opportunity in his shady garden in Herefordshire, and Frances Tophill invites viewers to grow easy summer vegetables along with her as she trials varieties for taste and productivity at RHS Rosemoor.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don shows what to do now to maximise next year's soft fruit crop by pruning his summer raspberries and planting on the strawberry runners he potted up a few weeks ago. As Monty harvests September's abundance in the vegetable garden he makes notes of the tastiest varieties he has grown this year which he would grow again next year, as well as sowing some quick growing crops to harvest in the autumn.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives advice on plants to use for foliage with tropical proportions, Arit Anderson continues investigating the use of peat and Carol Klein explores Oxford Botanic Garden's euphorbias.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Starting his journey at the sole surviving garden of the 1600s, Levens Hall in Cumbria, Monty sets out to investigate what the gardens of this age would have looked like and what influenced and inspired their creation.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty bases himself at Rousham House in Oxfordshire, designed by one of the first practitioners of the landscape movement, William Kent. It has survived almost unchanged since its completion in 1741.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the extraordinary transformations that occurred throughout the 19th century. As a result of an expanding empire, scientific and technological innovation and social change, British gardens became more exotic, more colourful and more widely accessible than ever before.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his journey through Britain's gardening heritage by looking at how the nation's gardens have evolved over the last hundred years. He looks at the profound effect that two world wars had on the attitude to gardens and gardening.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants out annuals in the jewel garden, adds agapanthus to the mound and finds a new home for his pelargoniums. Adam Frost visits an innovative kitchen garden at the Spurs training centre in North London, which provides fresh produce for its players, coaches and staff. In Wiltshire, Carol Klein's at a glorious early summer garden which employs clever use of curves, circles and spheres in its evergreen planting.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants out sweetcorn, checks in on his container veg and creates a display with fuchsias. With only a few weeks to go, Sue Kent shares an update on the progress of her first ever show garden, destined for the Hampton Court Palace Garden Festival. And there's a gardener in Somerset who couldn't live without roses in her garden.

On the shield volcano Waiʻaleʻale - the rainiest place on earth, scientists like Lukas Behnke are fighting for the preservation of endangered native animals and plants.

programme.title: The Lair of the White Worm
programme.desc: On a farm owned by Eve Trent (Catherine Oxenberg) and her sister Mary (Sammi Davis), young archaeologist Angus Flint (Peter Capaldi) discovers a large and inexplicable skull, which he soon deduces belonged to the D'Ampton Worm, a mythical beast supposedly slain generations ago by the ancestor of the current Lord D'Ampton (Hugh Grant). The predatory Lady Sylvia Marsh (Amanda Donohoe) soon takes an interest in both Flint and the virginal Eve, hinting that the vicious D'Ampton Worm may still live.

programme.title: Cutthroat Island
programme.desc: Feisty Morgan Adams (Geena Davis) inherits her late buccaneer father's galleon and one-third of a map to buried treasure located on Cutthroat Island. The map had been tattooed on her father's scalp, and to find the treasure, she must locate and scalp his two brothers. But Morgan's swashbuckling uncle, Dawg Brown (Frank Langella), wants the treasure for himself, and does battle with his headstrong niece and her unwilling accomplice, Latin-speaking physician William Shaw (Matthew Modine).

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After returning home to England, aristocrat Robin of Loxley learns that the evil Sheriff of Nottingham has seized his family estate. He soon joins forces with Friar Tuck and Little John -- a fierce Arabian warrior who wants to put an end to the Crusades. Armed with arrows and dubbed Robin Hood, Loxley leads a band of oppressed rebels in a daring plan to rob the Sheriff of his money and take away his power.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Steel Dawn

programme.desc: A cryptozoologist (Scott Adkins) tries to track down and save a mythological creature before his competitor (Dolph Lundgren) kills it.

programme.title: Come to Daddy
programme.desc: A privileged man-child arrives at the beautiful and remote coastal cabin of his estranged father, whom he hasn't seen in 30 years. He quickly discovers that not only is his dad a jerk, he also has a shady past that is rushing to catch up with him.

programme.title: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
programme.desc: The shadow of the Bellows family has loomed large in the small town of Mill Valley for generations. It's in a mansion that young Sarah Bellows turns her tortured life and horrible secrets into a series of scary stories. These terrifying tales soon have a way of becoming all too real for a group of unsuspecting teens who stumble upon Sarah's spooky home.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger.

programme.title: Draft Day
programme.desc: Sonny Weaver Jr. is the general manager of the Cleveland Browns. One of pro football's most important days, NFL draft day, is drawing near, but Sonny has much more on his mind than just which players to recruit. His lover is pregnant, and the team's owner wants to fire him. After Sonny accepts a deal with Seattle that nets him that team's first-round pick, he immediately wonders if he has made the right choice for himself and the Browns.

programme.title: Hands of Stone
programme.desc: At age 72, legendary trainer Ray Arcel (Robert De Niro) comes out of retirement to coach world-class Panamanian boxer Roberto Durán (Edgar Ramírez). Arcel becomes a mentor to the ferocious fighter, convincing him that winning ultimately comes down to strategy. After scoring knockout after knockout, Duran prepares for a bout against Sugar Ray Leonard, the undefeated lightweight champion. Five months later, on Nov. 25, 1980, the two titans meet for an infamous rematch that makes boxing history.

programme.title: Akeelah and the Bee
programme.desc: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

programme.title: La La Land
programme.desc: Sebastian (Ryan Gosling) and Mia (Emma Stone) are drawn together by their common desire to do what they love. But as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

programme.title: Girl Most Likely
programme.desc: After losing her job and her boyfriend, a woman moves in with her estranged mother and finds an assortment of strange characters inhabiting the home.

programme.title: Silver Linings Playbook
programme.desc: After losing his job and wife, and spending time in a mental institution, Pat Solatano winds up living with his parents. He wants to rebuild his life and reunite with his wife, but his parents would be happy if he just shared their obsession with the Philadelphia Eagles. Things get complicated when Pat meets Tiffany, who offers to help him reconnect with his wife, if he will do something very important for her in exchange.

programme.title: The Skeleton Twins
programme.desc: Following many years of estrangement, twins Milo (Bill Hader) and Maggie (Kristen Wiig) have an unexpected reunion after a set of near-tragedies. The situation forces them to confront how their lives became so broken. For Maggie, it means examining why she's so unhappy in a marriage to a loving husband. programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there. The house's history is checkered; for starters, it was built on top of where an insane asylum once stood. Seven women died - a man killed his wife and then himself. Lights turn themselves on and off, people have seen apparitions and heard footsteps, and a clock spontaneously comes to life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist. The Bissman Building has been in his family for five generations, and has its fair share of paranormal activity. Many believe the activity started in 1911 following a violent death where an employee was decapitated by the building's elevator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity. The claims there range from objects moving on their own to ghosts talking to people. A ghost with hollowed out eyes and long white hair confronted a guard, and another guard was poked in the head by one of the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims. Some of these claims include screams, voices, doors opening, singing, and a lady who forms standing next to a window. Steve and Grant get started on the door that opens on its own in the kitchen. Steve starts to open a nearby door and sure enough, the other door opens forcefully as well. Debunked!
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Haunt Is

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads south to Atlanta, Georgia to investigate Rhodes Hall, where they will be joined by the stars of the Real Housewives of Atlanta, NeNe Leakes, Sheree Whitfield, and Kim Zolciak. Traci Clark, the Hall's communications director, tells the team about the history and the activity that has been reported. Amos Rhodes built the home in 1904, and his family resided there for 20 years, before Amos passed away in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions and shadow figures to footsteps and conversations. A braid of hair and shoe were also found in the basement during renovations.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint. This mint-turned-museum has lots of reported activity, including shadow figures, thuds, noises, female apparitions, lights flickering and alarms going off. Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode on Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to South Dakota for the first time to investigate the Alex Johnson Hotel, a place filled with history. Some of the paranormal activity reported are apparitions, voices, objects being moved, growling sounds, and a story of a bride to be either being killed or committing suicide. The TAPS team also welcomes Maddie, the ghost-hunting dog.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Prospect, Maine to investigate Fort Knox, built before the Civil War to protect the Penobscot narrows. Some of the reported activity has been sounds of stones skipping, doors opening, apparitions, and a strong feeling of evil being felt. Britt is back with the TAPS team and the guys get set up. Jason and Grant start in Long Alley, and the guys see something strange appear on the thermal camera.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor. Some of the activity that has been reported is loud knocking, banging, footsteps, music, doors opening/closing, and the apparition of the former owner. Jason and Grant get started in the Quest Gallery, and they see a chain moving on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House. Some of the reported paranormal activity is a woman in white, as well as a gentleman in a period suit, and shadows. Some believe the Opera House's builder Charles Sterling haunts it, because he died two years before the building was complete.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels for the first time to Hawaii to investigate the Pacific Aviation Museum at Pearl Harbor in Honolulu. Steve can't fly, so he isn't able to make the trip, but Britt is helping out, as well as Destination Truth's Josh Gates. Some of the activity that has been reported is whispers, cold air being felt, apparitions, and cameras being turned on and off on command.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team travels to New Castle, Pennsylvania to investigate Hill View Manor. Before closing in 2004, this old nursing facility had many reports of death by suicide. Some of the paranormal claims by staff members includes unexplained reflections, voices, full body apparitions, shadow figures, the sounds of machines, and people seeing a little boy known as Jeffrey. After seeing Jeffrey, the patients would soon pass away.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal group to investigate Seaview Terrace in Newport, RI. Built in 1923 by the Bradley family, Seaview Terrace is recognizable from TV's "Dark Shadows" which filmed there in the 1960's. Some of the reported activity includes an apparition of Mrs. Bradley, voices, feelings of being watched, seeing faces, and the temperature fluctuating. Jason and Grant start out in the Great Hall and try to get Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the Carnegie Library Homestead, in Homestead, Pennsylvania. This Library was the site of violent riots between Carnegie and the steel workers. It is said that Carnegie built the library to win the steel workers over. It is thought that steel workers or Carnegie himself could be haunting the building. Some of the reported activity includes shadow figures, books falling off shelves, apparitions, and voices.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hawaii's Plantation Village, which was once a sugar plantation. It it is now an outdoor museum with reports of spirits still wandering the property and the many authentically replicated homes. It is believed that some of the entities seen are those who committed suicide or were murdered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to ever investigate the historic Friars Club in New York City. Built in 1904 and famous for its roasts, TAPS has been brought in to find out if comedian, Al Kelly, is behind all the activity. There have been reports that an old man can be heard grunting, cold air surrounding someone, lockers moving, shadows, and apparitions of a man sitting at a table.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Niagara Falls, NY to investigate paranormal activity that has been reported at Rapids Theater. Claims revolve around an actress who is said to have hanged herself backstage. People have heard the sound of high heels, whistling, doors opening and closing on their own and apparitions have being seen around the stage and bar areas.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Snug Harbor, in Staten Island, New York. The team is very excited to be joined by Meredith Vieira, who will help them investigate this large property that includes historic landmark buildings. The investigation focuses on a lady in white who has been seen floating throughout Snugs Harbor. She is believed to be a laundry worker, known as a Matron, who was murdered by her thirteen year old son, who she kept chained inthe basement.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads back to the fan favorite, Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Kentucky, where more activity has been reported and a nurse's wing has been opened up for TAPS to explore. The activity reported includes solid dark shadows and voices. Stave and Tango start out their night in the Death Tunnel where they hear sounds, and loud slams, but can't figure out what caused it.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to one of the oldest distilleries in America, Buffalo Trace, in Frankfort, Kentucky. Operating since the 18th century, its former president, Colonel Blanton, is believed to still be roaming the buildings. He worked and lived at the distillery for over 55 years, before passing away at his home, which was on the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called out to Hartford, CT to Elks Lodge, the oldest and largest secret fraternal organizations in the country. Elks Lodge #19 is shrouded in mystery and tragedy with a gruesome death hanging over its head....and decades of paranormal activity. Next they head to Morse Mill Hotel, in Morse Mill, Missouri - a hotel with a violent past. They are called in to help a client who is dealing with threatening spirits that emerged as renovations began.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Ohio to investigate Kings Island, an amusement park that sits on land that was the site of an awful accident. The workers here believe the people who died in the accident could be the ones still visiting the park. Some of the reported activity includes the sound of laughter, footsteps, objects being thrown, and a girl in a little blue dress who is said to be the ghost of a child buried in the nearby cemetery.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hales Bar Dam and Marina in Tennessee, to investigate a dam that was built on Native American land. It is believed that a Cherokee chief cursed this property after he was forced off it. Due to numerous problems, Hales Bar Dam took eight years to complete and was finally finished in 1907. During the building of this dam there were many tragedies such as accidental deaths, including workers being buried alive in cement walls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates a 19th century Bed and Breakfast in Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee, built by the Cloyd family. Over the years, many members of the Cloyd family passed away at this property. The current owners, the Coles, believe the Cloyds never left and are haunting the hotel. People have seen several full body apparitions, matching the descriptions of various Cloyd members. Whistling has been heard, a lady in pink has been seen as well as a man in black.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Wythe County, Virginia to answer a call for help at one of the town's most feared houses - The Graham Mansion. This foreboding, twenty-five room home has witnessed a twisted history of evil through the centuries starting with a slave owner in the 1700's who was murdered by his two slaves. In the 1800's, Squire David Graham purchased the home. His wife suffered from mental illness and was locked-up in the basement.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out to investigate the U.S. Naval Institute in Annapolis, Maryland, where a marine's death remains a mystery and his ghost still roams the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's final case draws near, but that doesn't stop the TAPS team from helping those in need. They head to Mount Joy, Pennsylvania to investigate Bube's Brewery to see if the late owner, Alois Bube, and his deceased family members are still presiding over the lager business. Alois purchased the brewery in 1876 and added on a Victorian hotel to serve his beer and accommodate overnight guests.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's last show draws even closer, but in the meantime the cases keep coming, and this one is very exciting for the whole team; the USS Yorktown in Mt. Pleasant, South Carolina. This is an 872-foot warship, which served in WWII as well as Vietnam and also recovered the Apollo 8 astronauts and space capsule. The USS Yorktown has carried thousands of men and lost more than 140 of them while in battle. Most were pilots who never returned from their missions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: As Grant's final show is now just a case away, the team revisits an old favorite of his, Mt. Washington in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire. Not only was this the resort Grant honeymooned at 15 years ago but it later became a location that provided incredible evidence for the team. Now there are new claims and more areas and rooms open to the TAPS team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the first episode back since Grant made his announcement that he wasleaving, TAPS pushes forward focusing on the case on hand. They head to the University of Rhode Island to investigate a Fraternity house that has been experiencing paranormal activity for decades. Purchased in 1936, a former Governor once resided in the house, and there is a claim that his little girl, Abigail, fell to her death there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. This historical Jail was the final destination of America's first female serial killer, Lavinia Fisher. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Rutledge, Georgia to investigate Camp Rutledge, a family friendly camp, that is anything but friendly at night. The call to help comes from a frightened mother, Melissa, who has attended the camp since she was 17 yrs, and now has a daughter old enough to start vacationing at the campsite. Melissa has witnessed many unexplained paranormal things, and wants to make sure it's safe before she takes her daughter there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to Alexandria, Louisiana to investigate the Alexandria Zoo, where the apparition of the longtime zookeeper and manager, Les has been seen. Les' longtime friend, Bill Hess called in TAPS after many longtime employees and friends noticed strange paranormal activity that reminded them of their dear friend. TAPS also introduces a new member, Ashley to the team and Jason promotes Adam to his new position, Investigator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate Fort Ontario, a place that was the only location in America to provide sanctuary for Jewish refugees during World War II. Built in 1755, this fort first saw battle during the French and Indian war, and is no stranger to bloodshed. ...and phenomena.

A sour director, Zach (Michael Douglas), and his brusque assistant (Terrence Mann) whittle down the ranks until they're left with 16 dancers. All tell their life stories -- some tragic, some comic -- and explain their love of dance. Tension mounts when Cassie (Alyson Reed) -- once both a big star and the director's lover but now desperate for a part -- auditions. But Zach must choose only the best for his show.

programme.title: Fatal Instinct
programme.desc: Ned Ravine (Armand Assante) is a police officer and lawyer who occasionally defends the delinquents he arrests. He crosses paths with a seductive femme fatale, Lola Cain (Sean Young), during an assignment and promptly begins an affair with her. Meanwhile, Ned's wife, Lana (Kate Nelligan), is deep in an affair of her own. Lana and her lover, Frank (Christopher McDonald), are planning to murder Ned in an elaborate fashion so they can collect on his triple indemnity life insurance policy.

programme.title: Burnt

Returning to London, he assembles a crew to create one of the finest restaurants ever and gain the recognition he has always wanted in the culinary world, but the journey is certainly not an easy one.

He claims to be a friend of their Ivy League children, and charms his way into the house. But when the couple discovers the truth about Paul and his real identity, they kick him out. As the couple trades stories with their friends about Paul, his presence proves surprisingly hard to shake.

programme.title: Coolest Places on Earth

programme.desc: Delicia Silva shows you why Aqua Wellness Resort and Spa in Nicaragua is a prime location to kick back, relax, and let life go up in smoke.

programme.sub-title: Events: Where There's Smoke There's Fire

programme.title: This Old House TV
programme.desc: Coming up on This Old House Progress on the 1920's bungalow continues. Kevin walks through the newly framed first floor. Jeff and the apprentices nail in the panels. Finding the right balance between efficiency and aesthetics is crucial to Dana and Donald.
programme.sub-title: Ramp Up the R Value | The Jamestown Net-Zero House

programme.title: Dermot Bannon's Incredible Homes

programme.title: The Life-Sized City

programme.title: Log Cabin Fever

programme.title: Holmes Inspection

Chase sees Kary as a challenge and the ultimate prize, but is he willing to give up his playboy ways for true love?

She's constantly pushed to the friend-zone by various men she encounters, and ends up with nothing but a broken heart. When she falls for the bad boy next door, Khalil, she finds that self-love can be more important, than her own idea of "love."

programme.title: Kingsmen

programme.title: Princess of the Trap House
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn't sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father's drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: Bad For You
programme.desc: Paris McMillan works as an undercover FBI agent taking down known crime rings in the city. When she meets Liam after a one-night stand, she discovers that he is her next target. Now she has to make the difficult decision about loyalty or love.

programme.title: Bottled Lust
programme.desc: Jasmine and her friends embark on a girls trip, as well as mend her heartbreak. She then meets John and is hit with a wave of feelings and butterflies. But when John starts to show his true colors, the girls end up in a dangerous situation.

programme.title: The Price of Fame
programme.desc: In the streets of Atlanta, Cassie, a struggling young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, a charismatic interviewer who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her cunning best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry. But as hidden agendas and betrayals emerge, Cassie finds herself questioning the cost of her dreams.

programme.title: One-2
programme.desc: Two detectives, Hart and Johnson work alongside local hustler Tae & G. They have similar personalities, but work on opposite sides of the law. While working to take down HeavyHand, a local kingpin, Hart finds himself at the mercy of another known gangster, and find himself working with Tae & G to bring them down.

programme.title: The Co-Signer
programme.desc: Released from prison, Mark makes the decision to change his ways. Kane has other plans in store for him.

programme.desc: Picking up after the events of the first film, Lock and Key press forward as their paths come dangerously close to crossing like never before. New revelations will come to light, just as a new, 'King' emerges and the fallout could cost them their lives.

programme.title: Dues Paid
programme.desc: Ava and Jessica are friends who cross paths with a drug dealer who offers them a job to help him legitimize his business after being under investigation. They start to cooperate with him by deterring the police during a murder investigation at the motel that Jessica works at. Lies and secrets are exchanged, and a world of gang related chaos begins to divide a once solid friendship.

programme.title: False Profits
programme.desc: Delilah is imprisoned for fraud after being apart of her family's gospel group which was a front for a ponzi scheme. She agrees to be interviewed by a local reporter about her past and her side of the crime. On the day of the interview, her sister performs a song hinting at hidden truths about her past.

programme.title: Perc 30
programme.desc: Shavonne Perkins has taken control of the biggest Percocet operation in Houston, TX. Her father Bapo, the head of the Perkins crime family, is in the midst of transferring his entire drug operation over to his youngest son, Brandon, knowing that the other children will not take the news lightly. Soon after the announcement, a price is put on the entire family's head. Bullets fly, lives are lost, and the family look to each other as to which one of them is responsible.

programme.title: Bootleg Church
programme.desc: After a church's Bishop dies, a new senior pastor, Pastor Moore, inherits the church, it's congregation and assets. Pastor Moore begins to use the church as a cover-up for his underground drug smuggling, money-laundering, and insurance fraud schemes. Soon Pastor Moore's lies, lust, and greed begin to entangle everyone, and everything around him into his world of crime, and within that world every kept secret will be revealed, and become his downfall.

programme.title: Misconception of a Father
programme.desc: The story of three fathers who must become men through the constant struggles of everyday life while living with the societal misconceptions that plagues the outlook of who they really are. The film speaks to several issues that continuously consume our society depicting the images of our African American men and the affect it contributes within their lives. The film also addresses some of the negative images that are constantly bestowed upon them by media, community and family alike.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]

But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Honest Thief

Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.
