programme.title: Sacrifice: From D-Day to the Liberation of Paris
programme.desc: June 6th, 1944, 3 PM: Allies secure beaches; Hitler misjudges, expecting main landings in Pas-de-Calais. Hope rises as French populace anticipates liberation, despite slow Allied progress in Normandy. Paris liberated in August; war persists for another year, marking Normandy's profound sacrifice.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: James Arness hosts this documentary report on what the United States Army, Air Force, and Navy did to contain the spread of Communism. The camera crews on location in South Vietnam show the military operations of our Special Forces units on how they live, how they operate, and what they did to work and fight with the South Vietnamese.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: the Hidden War in Vietnam

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The leaders of the Pacific are discussed: Chester M. Nimitz, Douglas MacArthur.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: Monday, April 16th, 1917, 6:00 AM, spring is slow to come in the North of France, a cold rain drowns the Chemin des Dames. It will soon snow all over the Aisne Department. However, all the Poilus who attack that day are sure..: This time it will be the end of the war. The offensive decided by the new commander-in-chief, General Nivelle, must take everything on its passage.
programme.sub-title: 1917 - The Second Battle of the Aisne

programme.title: Sword of Honour
programme.desc: The story is one man's heroic quest to fight for a deep moral cause and to reclaim his manhood after a shattering divorce from society beauty Virginia Troy.

programme.title: The Concise History of WWII
programme.desc: From Germany's dramatic invasion of Poland, France, and Russia, to the Battle of Britain, the key battles in Africa, and onto the attack of Pearl Harbour and the eventual defeat of the Nazi army in Stalingrad. This program focuses on all the major events of this period, and also pays particular attention to the war's final year and the gradual destruction of the German army.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: John Wayne hosts this video which was produced during the Vietnam War when the Communist threat was at its height.

programme.title: Einsatzgruppen: The Nazi Death Squads
programme.desc: Faced with the advancing Soviet troops, Nazi Germany decides to have the bodies of death camp victims dug up and burned in graves.

programme.title: Artillery: The Gods of War
programme.desc: Traditionally the artillery has been the major killer on the battlefield. The task of the infantry and cavalry have been to fix the enemy in place for the artillery to destroy them with massed fire. Traditionally the horse and foot artillery did the job with field guns and howitzers. The bulk of fire has been indirect as a result of advances in technology and man's understanding of ballistics.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: On July 3, 1940, the British fleet attacked the French navy at Mers el-Kébir, Algeria. In ten minutes, Bretagne sank, Mogador was destroyed, and Provence and Dunkerque were grounded. Over 1,300 French sailors died, a tragic outcome of allies turning against each other. Churchill justified the attack to prevent the ships from falling into German hands. This film examines this pivotal WWII moment.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler
programme.desc: Volume 3 - Why Hitler lost World War II: Examines the enormous sacrifice the free world paid to defeat Nazi Germany and examines Adolf Hitler's thirst for power and his bumbling military errors including letting the BEF escape at Dunkirk.
programme.sub-title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler: Volume 3 - Why Hitler Lost WWII

programme.title: Living in the Shadow of WWII
programme.desc: Every nation involved in the Second World War recognized that maintaining the morale of the population was vital. Everywhere a great effort was made to offer entertainment, diversion and often to package it with the reassurance that the cause was just and victory certain.

programme.title: Mission Invisible
programme.desc: The largest nuclear submarine ever built is Russian. Carrying 20 ballistic missiles inside its 179 meter long hull, the Typhoon-class ship has been designed as the weapon of last resort. Until now however, only glimpses of the largest and deadliest killing machine on Earth have been available.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: General George C. Marshall and Henry 'Hap' Arnold are profiled.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: By summer 1944, Germany has undeniably lost the battle of the USSR. After the Soviet victories at Moscow, Stalingrad, Kursk, and Leningrad, the Soviet Union, with its practically unlimited resources of manpower and matériel, begins to rapidly push the Germans back toward the German border. On 22 June 1944, Stalin launches Operation Bagration, named after a Russian hero of the Napoleonic Wars.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: On 22 June 1941, German pilots were the first to see the sun rise. Before the day was over, the Soviet Air Forces had lost almost 2 000 aircraft. The early German air superiority gave a significant boost to German confidence, and severely damaged Soviet military capability and morale.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Worldwide, the conflict continued to escalate as Japan made their presence felt as signatories of the Tripartite Pact, giving Hitler's Axis of Evil more power. Britain stood alone as the nightly bombing raids of the Blitz devastated major cities.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The Luftwaffe continued its attempts to bomb Britain into submission, while the German Afrika Korps strengthened its position as Rommel, Hitler's 'Desert Fox', took charge. At sea the naval forces battle each other and the elements.
programme.sub-title: On Land in the Air and All at Sea: January-March 1941

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Invasion of Southern France by the 7th army and subsequent junction with the American 3rd army in northwest part of France.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: The man who described himself as 'Jew Baiter Number One' was the publisher of the notorious Der Stürmer magazine which formed the anti-Semitic agenda in the Third Reich. Often overlooked by history Stretcher was hanged at Nuremberg.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: On 22 June 1941, German pilots were the first to see the sun rise. Before the day was over, the Soviet Air Forces had lost almost 2 000 aircraft. The early German air superiority gave a significant boost to German confidence, and severely damaged Soviet military capability and morale.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: In a last effort at glory, having lost most of their best men in military actions, Japan employs suicide pilots - Kamikaze - men who willingly crash their planes into ships in order to destroy the American spirit. But the U.S. Navy and Marines are ready for them with their guns, and they fought heroically against the onslaught. And on Okinawa, Americans fight a major battle with the Japanese Army.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: The town of Hotten became very important during WWII as Hitler has ordered it held at all costs because of its key defensive location by the Siegfried Line. An infantry regiment and tanks attack but are stopped by heavy mortar fire. A small squad succeeds by using grenades and .45 submachine guns, allowing the tanks and infantry to take the town after a fierce fight. Stars actor Jim Hutton.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 27 November 1942, the French fleet scuttled itself in Toulon, sending over 85 warships to the seabed to avoid German capture. This tragic act, born of defeat and collaboration, crippled the French Navy. Using archives, survivor accounts, and vivid reconstructions, the film revisits this dramatic and rarely explored chapter of World War II history.
programme.sub-title: Desperate Measures: The Scuttling of the French Fleet in 1942

programme.title: Artillery: The Gods of War
programme.desc: Traditionally the artillery has been the major killer on the battlefield. The task of the infantry and cavalry have been to fix the enemy in place for the artillery to destroy them with massed fire. Traditionally the horse and foot artillery did the job with field guns and howitzers. The bulk of fire has been indirect as a result of advances in technology and man's understanding of ballistics.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: In 2006, some of the very few Jewish survivors told their stories on camera. How does one get out of Auschwitz? How do you recover from this hell? How do you recall and recount the atrocities of the camp? And how can we pass on the memory of the Holocaust?

programme.title: Arnhem 1944
programme.desc: This is the tragic story of the last bridge in the ill-fated Operation Market-Garden, and features rare newsreel footage of the Allied operation that was supposed to end World War Two in 1944. Featuring extensive footage from the training films and newsreel cameras of both sides plus a return to the battlefield under the direction of Robert Kershaw, author of It Never Snows In September.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: The landing of our paratroopers near Munsan. The crossing of the Imjin River by Republic of Korean troopsThe 'one-two punch' of the 8th Army, the tank-infantry team crosses the 38th Parallel. A brief report on the activation of SHAPE in Paris with a few words from the former General of the Army, Dwight D. Eisenhower.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: The United Nations Forces Cross the 38th Parallel

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: We review the heroic and inspiring work of the Army Chaplain, especially the Chaplains who have served so gallantly with our fighting troops. The soldier looks to this clergyman in uniform as a friend and counselor, as well as a spiritual leader.

programme.title: Anzac Battlefields: The Western Front
programme.desc: The ANZAC's feel the brunt of Germany's Operation Michael, the biggest offensive of World War I.

programme.title: Afghanistan 1979-1989
programme.desc: This project aims to understand the causes of the Afghan war (1979-1989) and its accurate coverage. It started on Dec 12, 1979, when the Politburo members (Leonid Brezhnev, Yuri Andropov, Andrey Gromyko, Dmitry Ustinov) decided to send troops. It was the Soviet Union's first operation outside the Warsaw Pact, becoming their longest and forgotten war.

programme.title: Sword of Honour
programme.desc: The story is one man's heroic quest to fight for a deep moral cause and to reclaim his manhood after a shattering divorce from society beauty Virginia Troy.

programme.title: Bombers of WWII: Allied & Axis Bombers
programme.desc: Using authentic footage; this program covers the finer details, advantages and shortcomings of the bombers used by the British, Americans and Germans during World War II. Bombers include: The Avro Lancaster, Halifax, Manchester, Short Stirling, Wellington, the B-17 Flying Fortress, B-25 Mitchell, B-24 Liberator, Heinkel He 111, Junkers 88 and Junkers 188, He 177 & the Stuka Ju-87 Dive Bomber.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: General Nenarokov arrives from army HQ with reports of a secret chemical-weapons test site. Allies back an ultimatum on reciprocal chemical warfare but need proof the Wehrmacht will use toxins. Aerial reconnaissance must find the facility and a weak point in the German encirclement.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: These are the best of times for the US. Prohibition doesn't stop anyone from having a good time, the country is on wheels or listening to the radio, welcoming the talkies or investing in the stock market with reckless optimism. It's that brief spell they call the Jazz Age, the age of Charles Lindbergh and Babe Ruth.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Transport Aircraft
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry focuses on transport aircraft, such as the Junkers JU-52, Douglas DC-3, PBY Catalina, Short Sunderland, and more.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: Midway was the turning battle in the Pacific. A training film which analyses this great battle from the Commander's viewpoint. Midway was the turning battle in the Pacific. Activities of Marines, Pilots and Sailors are shown before, during, and after the attack.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane visits Laconia, where the famous Kalamata olive is cultivated, to follow the famous olive from harvest to table. After a chilly day of collecting, scoring, and processing the ripened fruits, Diane heads to the kitchen to whip up an olive feast. Find out how olives can transform any meal into a masterpiece.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The World's Most Famous Olive

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane travels to her family's native island of Ikaria, where locals are 10 times more likely to live to one hundred than Americans. Diane's young 85-year-old neighbors share a lesson in making wild herb teas; a beekeeper reveals the honey that is one of the secrets to Ikarians' renowned longevity. Enjoy the deliciously simple and wonderfully healthy cuisine of Ikaria.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Flavors of Longevity - Ikaria

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores the ancient grains that Greek cooks still love to use. Learn how to incorporate timeless ancient grains into every meal of the day.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Ancient Grains for Modern Cooks

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Emerald green Greek extra virgin olive oil is the star of this show. Diane takes us on a journey to the stunningly preserved town of Monemvasia. Explore the diversity and beauty of one of Greece's most delectable exports.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Olive Oil Everything

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores the meze tradition of small plates of vibrant food meant to be shared. She uncovers the vast variety and robust flavors of the meze table and invites a wine expert into the kitchen for advice on what to pair when the meal includes spice, yogurt, cheese, crunch, comfort, seafood, meat and more, all in one sitting. Discover the fun and festive meze tradition.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Meze Society

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Go on a picnic at a vineyard in Naoussa were one grape dominates the table: the local Xinomavro, one of Greece's noblest reds. On the wine trail, Diane discovers bread, cookies and chocolate truffles all spiked with this hard-to-pronounce but easy-to-love Greek varietal. Learn how to incorporate incomparable Greek wine into any menu, both as a drink and an ingredient.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - A Bite of Greek Red Wine

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane celebrates the intensely flavored food and unique wines of one of Greece's most breathtaking islands, Santorini. Diane hops in a boat to pick capers on this volcanic island. She visits a renowned vineyard which still practices the island tradition of growing grapes in basket-shaped vines. Enjoy the tastes of Santorini with ingredients from field to sea.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Flavors Of A Volcano

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques suggests that mastering simple skills and techniques will make your life easier and when you're comfortable in the kitchen, you'll be more creative and avoid the trap of a quick fix with a frozen meal...or worse! He teaches you how to sharpen knives, cut and prepare vegetables and eggs and finally make a delicious gratin.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Kitchen Techniques

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacues knows that most of us want to eat a healthy diet with lots of organic produce. Now so much is available at farmers markets and in grocery stores, you don't have to spend a fortune if you chose what's in season when it tastes the best. But for those times you're in a hurry, it's okay to grab prewashed, precut or frozen vegetables to make your life easier.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Vegetables Every Way

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques shows that with a well-stocked pantry and a few good cooking techniques, you can make a tasty dish or a simple meal. His pantry essentials include potato flakes for a simple soup, spaghetti for a quick main dish, lentils, canned salmon, polenta and finally, in the freezer, a poundcake that can be transformed into a celebration dessert.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Budget Cooking from the Pantry

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Gathering with family and friends around the table or for a game of boules is the life's greatest pleasure for Jacques. He makes chicken wings, cucumber soup, merguez sausage, zucchini canapes, hummus and his father's Fromage Fort. Simple food that can be made ahead means that you can enjoy a glass of wine with your company.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Party Time

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques loves seafood and feels lucky to live by Long Island Sound with its wonderful stocks of Atlantic fish and shellfish. He prepares scallops, crab and cod--raw, fried, sauteed or grilled in dishes that are quick, simple and delicious.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Simply Seafood

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: When the weather heats up it's time for family dishes that work on the grill or in the pan. Jacques' great summer menu with Asparagus in Butter Sauce, a Grilled Steak with Zucchini, topped with Anchovy Butter, Curly Dogs for the kids. He shows you classic ways to cut potatoes and ends with a Patriotic Raspberry and Blueberry Galette.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Summer Cookout

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques celebrates birthdays, anniversaries and holidays with special meals. It's when he splurges on caviar, oysters, even truffles-the ultimate extravagance. These occasions are a time to gather together around the table with family and friends and indulge in our favorite foods and wines.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Lavish Indulgences

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques doesn't always eat dessert at home, but when he does, it's usually some kind of seasonal fruit. Classics like Baked Apple Bon Femme, Bananas Flambe, Cherry Compote or Pears in Puff Pastry... are served often. A new favorite is a British Lemon Posset. Other simple staples are Blueberries with Lemon and Mint or Grapefruit with Apricot Sauce, all great ways to end a meal.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Fruit Deserts

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's granddaughter Julia joins her in the kitchen to prepare a large pot of bubbling polenta and crostini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia prepares savory egg battered zucchini roll ups and a simple fennel, red onion, and celery salad.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's first dish is a velvety lettuce soup in a fontina gratin; she then makes a juicy pork tenderloin with balsamic onions. Lastly, she prepares string beans with rocky mashed potatoes made with garlic and olive oil.
programme.sub-title: Lidia's Kitchen - Quick and Delicious Braises

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia introduces this episode with "beautiful vegetables and a hot oven: a great marriage!" She then begins the meal with a simple and refreshing sesame and fava bean dip, perfect for flatbreads. Next, she prepares a baked eggplant stuffed with meat and vegetables, topped with a golden, cheesy crust. Her unique version of baked potatoes is made with pancetta and oregano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a linguine with Swiss chard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today Lidia shows how to perfectly prepare delicious seared steak with rosemary sauce, shallots and mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Focaccia is an irresistible, crunchy Italian flatbread. It's great for sandwiches and even for stuffing. Lidia begins by making a classic rosemary and lemon focaccia; she then moves on to a filled focaccia with smoky speck and fontina cheese. To finish these two lunchtime and snack favorites, she creates a salad of shrimp, fava, and cranberry beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about stock and soup! Join Lidia as she prepares three heart-warming soups. Chicken stock made into "Stracciatella", laced with eggs and spinach, Stuffed Veal Chop with oozing Fontina, and a Braised Kale with Bacon.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom learn the secrets behind the perfect traditional English roast dinner in London's historic Borough Market, explore the best of the diverse food offerings in Brick Lane and pop in to see their friend, Sir Ian McKellen, in his pub in East London.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - London

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom traverse the Isles of Lewis and Harris, where they attend an agricultural show and are invited to a traditional Scottish cèilidh. They meet the Hebridean Baker who treats them to an alfresco dinner on the Isle of Taransay, and visit the Isle of Harris Distillery to try their offering of gin and whisky.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Scotland

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom head to Dom's hometown of Manchester, the world's first industrialised city and now a vibrant food capital. They brunch at cult diner Gooey, learn to cook curry at a classic "Rice & Three" café, explore the science behind ice cream cones, and enjoy a special tour of Manchester United's iconic stadium.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Manchester

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom journey across Costa Rica from the northern Pacific coast to San José. In Nicoya, a renowned Blue Zone, they uncover dietary secrets linked to long, healthy lives. Venturing into the jungle, they work on a coffee plantation and discover why Costa Rica is the world's leading exporter of pineapples.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Costa Rica

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: The key to every fabulous entrée, is a fabulous sauce. Chef Stellino guides you through a the simple preparation of an elegant sauce for your everyday meal. A blast from the past ,a sweet upside-down pineapple cake that will rekindle your memory and seduce your palate.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Pork Chops and Pineapple Upside-down Cake

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Chef Stellino shares his sauce making secrets, to inspire the viewers with this elegant and sophisticated Mango and Ginger sauce that is easy to make and tastes delicious! He also shares some important fact about the uniqueness of the Black cod and his step by step secrets on how to plate this dish with the refined elegance of a professional chef.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Black Cod with Mango and Ginger Sauce and Sautéed Green Beans

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Meatloaf when done right can be a work of art, something worthy of the finest restaurant. It is all about technique and it is never hard to do right. Chef Stellino re-interprets for his viewers a fabulous Sicilian recipe from his youth and in the process he shares with them a series of foolproof techniques for getting done right every time.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Stuffed Meatloaf and Cake with Rum Sauce!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Cooking the perfect pork chop and preparing the ultimate sauce with port and Gorgonzola is a easy as 1-2-3! Making the perfect ricotta cheesecake is even easier. Chef Stellino loves to share his tips and techniques with a passionate delivery and easy to follow instructions.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Chops with Port & Gorgonzola Sauce and Ricotta Cheesecake

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: How not to overcook shrimp!! Chef Stellino guides the viewer though a series of tips and techniques on how to make incredibly flavorful shrimp recipes which are fool proof and look and taste like a million dollars.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Sizzling Shrimp Dishes

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Some call this the ultimate dinner, a perfectly cooked NY steak with a Vodka martini sauce! Chef Stellino once again shares all of his secrets in the making a an iconic sauce , the perfect accompaniment to the king of steaks: The New York. Then to sum it all up he shares with us a lusciously sweet, easy to make dessert of pears braised with Marsala!
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Ultimate Steak Dinner

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: A soup can be a form of art! Chef Stellino shares his secrets for the perfect soups, smooth , luscious and elegant. Plus he shows the viewers a series of simple techniques to create elegant topping to dress it all up. Simple clear instructions with step by step demonstrations on how to get it done in one try!
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Luscious Soups!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: A great dish does not have to be difficult to make in order to taste great! Fresh ingredients and simple techniques are at the core of these fabulously, delicious recipes. Chef Stellino guides the viewers along each step with humor and passion. He also shares his plating techniques that will help the viewers enhance the look of their finished dishes.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Grilled Shrimp with Peppers and Tuna with Tomato Salad

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Easy does it!, a delicious way to prepare a simple dish packed with flavor and panache, with easy to follow step by step instructions and plating directions. An old school recipe made simple for today's busy home chefs.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - A Delicious Chicken Dinner

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Nick prepares some of his favourite recipes including pasta with shrimp and zucchini, veal saltimbocca and cherry almond rice pudding.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Nick's Favorites

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Nick prepares French toast with butter braised strawberries in a cassis sugar, matzo brei, a breakfast burrito and kir royale.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Breakfast Favorites

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Nick Stellino makes terrine of roasted eggplant pasta alla russa; tarte de tatin; upside-down apple pie.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Upside-down Apple Pie

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Journey back in time to uncover Boone's historic roots and savor its vibrant culinary scene. Chef Walter Staib tries his hand at fly-fishing and connects with modern pioneers shaping the region's food culture. Delve into the historic Tatum Cabin, where delightful recipes are prepared, capturing the essence of Boone's heritage.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Flavors of the High Country - Boone, North Carolina

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib travels to the enchanting Pacific island of New Caledonia and discovers the harmonious fusion of French and indigenous Kanaky culture and the mouthwatering cuisine born from this blend. From a centuries-old Bougna recipe to the French pastry shops that dot the capital city, New Caledonia is a culinary treasure.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Paris of the Pacific - New Caledonia

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib explores the rich cultural heritage of New York City. From the diverse influences that have shaped the city for centuries, to a visit to a downtown restaurant that embodies its multicultural spirit. At the historic Harriton house, Chef Staib prepares recipes that pay homage to New York's roots.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Melting Pot Metropolis - New York City

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Embark on a captivating history of Machias, Maine and the first naval battle of the Revolutionary War. Gain insight into the region's sustainable practices and the symbiotic relationship between the land and sea. Inspired by the local bounty, Chef Staib creates mouthwatering recipes that celebrate this remarkable coastal town.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Tides of a Revolution - The Battle of Machias Bay

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Travel to Old Fort Harrod in Harrodsburg, Kentucky to explore the history of the fort and life of James Harrod. Joined by Mary Barlow, Chef Walter Staib pays tribute to the culinary heritage in the George Rogers Clark Cabin, they prepare historic recipes including a Kentucky Elk roast and a delightful Stack Cake, showcasing the traditional flavors of the region.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Birthplace of Kentucky - Harrodsburg, Kentucky

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib takes a journey Down Under to Sydney, Australia, where he learns of the regenerative techniques Australian Farmers use to create delicious-tasting Beef and support a sustainable future for the planet. Get ready for a sizzling adventure that celebrates the flavors of Australia in true "Barbie" style!
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Grilling Down Under - New South Wales, Australia

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Join Chef Staib on a flavorful journey through Melbourne, Australia, as he dives into the vibrant culinary scene of this multicultural city. From meeting talented local chefs to uncovering the source of Australian lamb in the countryside, experience the diverse flavors and cultural pulse that make Melbourne a true food lover's paradise.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - A Multicultural Menu - Victoria, Australia

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib explores Delaware's pivotal role in American history while savoring mouthwatering dishes like Spicy Corn Relish, Stewed Codfish, and Macaroons. Discover how Delaware's small but significant contributions helped shape American culture and politics, from its early Dutch and Swedish settlements to its crucial involvement in the Revolutionary War.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Flavors of the First State - Delaware

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib travels into the heart of Oaxaca, Mexico to embark on a captivating journey that uncovers the art of Mezcal making, guided by local experts who reveal the secrets behind this beloved spirit. The mysteries of the ancient city of Monte Albán await discovery, while renowned Mexican Chef, Rodolfo Castellanos showcases the vibrant flavors of the central market's local cuisine.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Savoring Oaxaca - The Spirit of Mezcal

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Join us on a spirited journey as we explore the rich history of Applejack and Apple Brandy, discovering their colonial origins and witnessing the meticulous distillation process at America's oldest distillery. Chef Walter Staib returns to the historic Harriton House to fire up some apple-inspired recipes, including Scallopini of Pork with Stuffing, a sizzling Apple Flambé, and more.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Applejack - The Original Colonial Elixir

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Want to turn a veggie loather into a veggie lover? Ellie reveals some tantalizingly simple ways to reform veggie haters, in the kitchen and beyond. Recipes include Broccoli Pesto Pizzas, Beef and Mushroom Sloppy Joes, and Raw Brussel Slaw.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Veggie Love

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie helps you get the bold taste you crave from your favorite foods while keeping salt in check in your kitchen. Recipes include 3-ingredient Coriander Crusted Turkey Breast, Sweet & Spicy Roasted Root Vegetable, Tri-Color Salad Pizza, and Family Favorite Minestrone Soup.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Big Flavor, Less Salt

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Raw foods are on hot now. But cooked foods have unique benefits too. Let Ellie suss out the facts from the hype for you. Recipes include Gazpacho, 3 Ingredient Tomato Sauce, Zucchini Carpaccio, and Wok Charred Lettuce with Shrimp.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Raw Vs Cooked

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie hits refresh on the typical brunch menu with some creative, make-ahead crowd-pleasers that break the mold. Recipes include Eggs Florentine in Tomato Cups, Breakfast Strata, Pumpkin Waffles, and 3 Ingredient Brussel Sprout Hash with Egg.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Better Brunch

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Americans get more than 25% of calories from snacks. Ellie shows how to make them count with some great ways to satisfy the cravings we get around the clock. Recipes include 3-ingredient Chocolate Grape Banana Skewers, Nutty Oatmeal Bars, Spring Cottage Peas with Basil, and Hummus with Cumin-Roasted Carrots.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Snack Attack

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Tired of snoring through your salad? Shake up the same-old same-old with some recipes that awaken all the senses. Recipes include Spinach Salad with Roasted Squash, Pumpkin Seeds and Roasted Grapes, Green Salad with Chicken & Buttermilk Dressing, Cauliflower Tabbouleh, and 3 Ingredient pickled red onions.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Unboring Salads

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Intrigued by all those exotic grains that have popped up on your grocer's shelves, but don't know where to start? Ellie gets granular with grains, including many that offer refreshing alternatives for those who are gluten-free. Recipes include Breakfast Grain Bowl, Sorghum Salad, Chickpea and Farro Stew, and 3-ingredient Popcorn-parsley & parmesan.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Great Grains

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: On the menu, desserts with a one-two punch-they satisfy your sweet tooth and deliver significant health benefits at the same time. Recipes include Blackberry Sage Ice Pops, Honey Yogurt Tart with Graham Cracker Crust, Pear Brown Betty, and 3-ingredient recipe Chocolate Almond Bark with Cherries.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Desserts With Benefits

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie shows you how to get great flavor and color with whole ingredients when you're cooking at home... and how to identify added colors, flavors and preservatives in prepared foods. Recipes include Cupcakes with 3 colorful frostings, Yogurt ranch (slaw), 3-ingredient maple vinaigrette, and Grilled Chicken with Cherry Bourbon BBQ Sauce.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Keeping It Real

programme.title: More! Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie Krieger returns in More! Ellie's Real Good Food. In this pilot, she busts the myth that fruit has too much sugar, showing how its natural sweetness comes with fiber, water, and nutrients. With recipes like Breakfast Smoothie Packs, Date Sweetened Baked Beans, Chicory Citrus Salad and Strawberries with Cannoli Cream, she proves healthy eating can be simple and joyful.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Wrangler Tailgate. Since picnickers in 1869 ate food from buckboards of horse-drawn wagons, Americans have loved tailgating. Now the party goes global, with pulled lamb from a wood-burning smoker at Odys & Penelope in L.A. Honey Soy Chicken Wings on skewers and Brisket Tacos, make magisterial main dishes. True global tailgating, with a Peruvian potato salad with chili-spiked cheese sauce.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wrangler Tailgate

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Extreme Grilling. Long before grills, charcoal, rotisseries, and planchas, there was fire! We visit L.A.'s Chi SPACCA, for a monster pork tomahawk grilled over wood by chef Ryan DeNicola. Extreme grilling with salmon steaks, smoky, on a shovel in a blazing campfire. Caveman-style pork chops directly on blazing embers with a sizzling poblano pan-fry and decadent brownies on a cedar plank.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Extreme Grilling

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Grilling 24/7. The world's pit masters, fire up grills, smokers, or wood-burning ovens for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late night snacks. For breakfast, farm eggs grilled with Parmesan, and prosciutto. For lunch, pizzas from the Industrial Eats in Buellton, CA. Pastrami Beef Ribs make a spectacular supper, and midnight snack of smoky, salty South African Grilled Cheese sandwiches.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones enter the cloistered and old-fashioned world of Midsomer Priory after a nun is found strangled. Jones visits the local pub, where he learns that a woman was seen acting strangely on the day of the murder, and that teenagers in the area sneak into the priory grounds for romantic liaisons. Later, the nuns discover that a valuable silver altar set has vanished, then the chaplain is found murdered.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed. Patrick Morgan met his death while hoping to sight a rare bird, but is his obsession with ornithology to blame - or something more sinister? Barnaby and Jones attempt to discover the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Barnabys plan to renew their wedding vows for their 25th anniversary when Tom is distracted by a murder of a dying man committed with an Indian sword in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The naked body of a young woman is found strangled in a local woodland nine years after three identical murders took place there. As DCI Barnaby and DS Troy investigate the killings, they are led further and further into the murky, clandestine world of Midsomer Worthy.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Mysterious events and the discovery of his relative's body lead the residents of Aspern Tallow to believe that Jonathan Lowrie's ghost is at large in their community. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy attempt to determine whether these strange occurrences are supernatural or if there is a more rational explanation.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the sleepy village of Martyr Warren, two opposing groups of travellers have set up home. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy are called in to investigate when the local magistrate, principal adversary of the new arrivals in the village, is found shot dead at his home.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When wealthy landowner Gregory Lancaster's body goes missing on the night of his death, a sinister web of secrets and lies is exposed in the village of Little Malton as Barnaby, Nelson and Kam Karimore are drawn into a world of body-snatching.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Mysterious lights are seen in the sky over famous UFO hot-spot Cooper Hill. When a local forest ranger suffers a strange death, the visiting UFO spotters are convinced aliens are responsible. DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson unearth suspicions, betrayals and long-buried secrets in their search for the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: An international cycling competition comes to the Midsomer village of Burwood Mantle. When the race leader is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson find themselves drawn into a ruthlessly competitive world of blackmail, bribery and bloodshed where winning comes at any cost.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Art comes to the picturesque Midsomer village of Angel's Rise with the opening of a new sculpture park. When its launch is marred by murder, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson have to get creative if they are to crack a case where art imitates death, and everything has a deeper meaning.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The discovery of a Saint's bones at an archaeological dig causes a stir in the village of Midsomer Cicely. But when the leader of the dig is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson soon realise that it is not only skeletons that have been long buried in the hallowed ground.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The annual harvest fair and the daredevil riders of the Wall of Death arrive in Whitcombe Mallet; the owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his horse.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: With the help of Acting DC Ben Jones, Barnaby investigates the garrotting of a husband and wife outside a deserted cottage near Midsomer Newton. Despite a reputation for being haunted, Winyard is a magnet for villagers, developers and conservationists. Barnaby and Jones must separate truth from rumour in order to reveal the cottage's secrets - and catch the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Midsomer Barton is celebrating Oak Apple Week when a mother is found drowned. It looks like suicide, and that she was driven to it by grief over her dead daughter. Barnaby investigates and is shaken by two villagers who look like murder victims from his past. Then another body is discovered, and it appears that the festivities have stirred up a cocktail of adultery, contempt, unrequited love and revenge in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The death of wealthy aristocrat Sir Freddy Butler brings Barnaby and Jones to the privileged surroundings of Haddington Hall. It looks like Freddy suffered a heart attack, but when his will disappears and his lawyer is killed in an arson attack, the detectives close in on Freddy's family. What are they hiding, and where are the mysterious Haddington diamonds?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When council clerk Martin Barrett is shot dead, Barnaby and Jones discover that he was an expert blackmailer. They investigate which of his victims hated him enough to kill him, and the trail leads to Fennacombe Bay. Why are Richard and Maggie Florian spending so much time at sea, and could police committee chairman Sir John Waverley have a scandalous past? With the help of Barnaby, they intend to find out.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A battle of the sexes which has raged in Broughton since the First World War comes to a head when ageing feminist Mildred Danvers is found dead after returning to her childhood home. As Barnaby investigates, the misogynist vicar Rev Gantis is shot through the head during a humiliating donkey race at the village fair. Is the killer on the side of the men or women - or do tragedies in Broughton's past hold the answer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Controversial plans to build a supermarket in Elverton-cum-Latterly lead to murder when a man is stabbed to death and the pollution advisor for the site seems to be spending more time with the women of the village than at work. Can Barnaby and Jones discover the truth and learn what is really polluting Elverton?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Midsomer Worthy's baritone Connor Simpson is killed just days before a competition, the rest of the choir, including Joyce Barnaby, are in fear for their lives. Barnaby and Jones investigate and find an atmosphere of bitter rivalry and tense marital relationships. Then, there's another murder and the race is on to catch the killer before the choral showdown.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby begins to question the guilt of a Midsomer Malham woman who is on trial for the murder of her best friend. The evidence is stacked against her, but she doesn't appear deluded or obsessed with the dead woman's husband as the prosecution claim. With the help of a frail pensioner - the key witness, can Barnaby and Jones discover what really happened on the night of the murder?

'The Dark Alley' lights up in a furor of incredible kung fu fighting and ruthless revenge that will leave you breathless'

programme.title: 52 Masters
programme.desc: Will takes a class with Sensei David Dye and learns about the intersections between Aikido, Karate, Judo and Lua.
programme.sub-title: 52 Masters: SHUYOKAN RYU MARTIAL ARTS with David Dye

programme.title: 52 Masters
programme.desc: Will trains in the physically punishing Kyokushin-Kan style of full-contact Karate with Shihan Tom Callahan.
programme.sub-title: 52 Masters: KYOKUSHIN-KAN KARATE with Tom Callahan

programme.title: Dynamite Shaolin Heroes: Sho Kosugi Ninja Theatre Vol. 5
programme.desc: After the fall of the Ming Dynasty, China is thrown into turmoil. The loyalists seek the return of Ming; the government is determined to stay in power. The only difference between the two is one saves lives, while the other takes it away.

programme.title: Raiders of Buddhist Kung Fu
programme.desc: At the turn of the century an ex-official, Nan Kit, conspires to restore the Manchu Dynasty and practices the secret and deadly Buddhist Break Neck Palm to become indestructible. Opposing him is Wong Lung, who must learn the Iron Flowers Shadow Fist from Iron Wu to have any chance of beating this mighty adversary.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo
programme.desc: Warriors of Budo Episode One: Karatedo begins at the Okinawan dojo of Sensei Morio Higaonna acknowledged as a true Warrior of Budo. A warrior trains his entire life for a moment that may never arrive. As a master of the fighting arts, achieving victory in a fight that may even mean death, can be a simple matter. Yet at the highest level, a Warrior of Budo will choose peace instead of conflict. Sensei Morio Higaonna is a Warrior of Budo.
programme.sub-title: Warriors of Budo Episode One: Karatedo

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: The lone wolf made a promise to a dying undercover Yagyu ninja, to bring his wife to be together with him in the afterlife. This promise led Itto to a village with only women, whose sole purpose is to give birth to new ninjas.
programme.sub-title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 7

programme.title: Thundering Ninja
programme.desc: A Ninja Organization and the C.I.A. are fighting each other for the plans of a missile.

programme.title: Deadly Silver Spear
programme.desc: A Wang Yu as Silver Spear meets the Flying Guillotine. He is hired by a noblewoman to do away with three top-class Kung Fu masters, but news reaches the ears of the white haired man, who deploys his own killers to deal with "Silver Spear". Unperturbed, "Silver Spear" continues on his mission to take down all three master fighters!

programme.title: Ninja the Battalion
programme.desc: Four scientists are kidnapped by unscrupulous gangsters of a syndicate who force the scientists to develop a bacteriological warfare program. There are only a few who can deal with the Syndicate! The Ninja-Battalion is committed and is to find the location of the scientists, free them and eradicate the Syndicate. Their relentless opponents are the secret service professionals of the Eastern Powers.

programme.title: Adventure at Shaolin
programme.desc: Champ Wang and Polly Shang Kwan star. The early exploits of the founder of Tai Chi, Chang Zhang Fong. While at the Shaolin temple, he finds secret manuscripts that lead to his expertise in the Crane and Snake styles of kung fu, and a series of battles begin.

programme.title: Dreaming Fists with Slender Hands
programme.desc: The title characters are a group of abandoned orphans. The kids find a home of sorts when they join a group of street performers. In Dickensian fashion, they're entertainers by day, do-gooders the rest of the time. An interesting combination of styles lifts this one well above the ordinary.

programme.title: Leg Fighters aka Invincible Kung Fu Legs
programme.desc: Tan, a kung fu kicking expert, kills the leader of the Ground Kick School in a private duel. He soon is hired to train a princess and her servant in kung fu. Awesome kicking ensues, when the brother of the school leader is out to get revenge on Tan.

programme.title: Crane Fighter
programme.desc: A beautiful young girl (Judy Lee) secretly learns the deadly art of the Crane technique against the wishes of her father, himself a former Shaolin man.Soon Judy becomes an expert and has a run-in with local Manchu lackeys who are on the warpath for all Shaolin students. Enter the debonair Raymond Lui, who teams up with Judy, and together they defeat the evil Manchu warlord Kao Chin Chun.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio llega al hotel para evitar que Ximena escape, donde se enfrenta al Turco por su engaño. Mejía le pide a Benítez que no le diga al presidente sobre sus sospechas del asesinato de Colmenares.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente Benítez le dice a Marco Mejía que lo respalda y que jamás negociará con criminales. Aurelio espera una respuesta. Chacorta lleva a Matilde al hospital, y Heriberto se pone muy mal.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio invita a comer a Ximena, pero el Cabo y sus hombres llegan hasta el restaurante donde él está y se presenta una balacera. Chacorta se venga de Heriberto al saber de su relación con Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta llevarse a Ximena al extranjero, pero ella logra desarmar a uno de los hombres de Aurelio y lo amenaza. Doña Alba no acepta irse con él, y le canta las verdades en su cara.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio regresa a México y se lleva una sorpresa cuando llega a la bodega, por lo que decide cambiarse el rostro. El Cabo le dice al Chema que él se encarga de encontrar a Casillas con ayuda de Irina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas se somete a cirugía estética, pero el procedimiento se complica y Heriberto pierde el control. Rutila le miente a Ximena por temor al Turco: le dice que extraña a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Todos creen que Aurelio Casillas ha muerto en una sala de operaciones. Sin embargo, la muerte que tanto impactó al mundo del narco mexicano es, en realidad, una mentira de quien busca venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio captura al Turco y lo tortura para descubrir dónde está el dinero que le robó. Mientras, el Chema Venegas, desconfiando de los Casillas, ordena a Tijeras secuestrar a doña Alba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de un tiroteo, Chacorta y sus hombres rescatan a doña Alba. El Chema se obsesiona con conocer la verdad sobre la muerte de Aurelio, y pide la lista de doctores que lo operaron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema les ofrece refugio al Turco y la familia de Aurelio en una de sus casas de Los Ángeles para tenderles una trampa. Mónica tiene que matar al cocinero para poder escapar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica vuelve a casa y se encuentra con noticias impactantes. Tras una llamada de su hija Rutila, Aurelio recorre Los Ángeles en busca del Turco y su familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena confiesa que no ama al Turco, que solo sintió agradecimiento por él. Después de matar a Ronnie, Aurelio encuentra a su exesposa, quien le dice que nunca volverá con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de separarse tras el tiroteo, Aurelio y Ximena se reúnen con sus hijos. El Turco usa a Irina para averiguar el paradero de Casillas, y así poder negociar con él.

programme.desc: Matilde quiere aliarse con Chema para hacer un negocio a espaldas de Chacorta. Lay se mete a la tina con Aurelio y, luego de algunas confesiones, pasan una noche de pasión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio visita a Mónica para amenazarla, pero ella recuerda el daño que él le hizo y se defiende. Más tarde, los hombres de Leonor se enfrentan a Chacorta y a Heriberto en una emboscada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio invita a comer a Ximena, pero el Cabo y sus hombres llegan hasta el restaurante donde él está y se presenta una balacera. Chacorta se venga de Heriberto al saber de su relación con Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta llevarse a Ximena al extranjero, pero ella logra desarmar a uno de los hombres de Aurelio y lo amenaza. Doña Alba no acepta irse con él, y le canta las verdades en su cara.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio regresa a México y se lleva una sorpresa cuando llega a la bodega, por lo que decide cambiarse el rostro. El Cabo le dice al Chema que él se encarga de encontrar a Casillas con ayuda de Irina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas se somete a cirugía estética, pero el procedimiento se complica y Heriberto pierde el control. Rutila le miente a Ximena por temor al Turco: le dice que extraña a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le tiende una trampa al Turco y lo amenaza, pero no recibe respuestas sobre el dinero. Después de mucho buscar a Leo, Ignacio Miravalle la encuentra y jura ayudarla a salir de la cárcel.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica sugiere que Aurelio negocie su propia mercancía y la divida con los colombianos. Doña Alba se interpone cuando la idea separa a los hermanos Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se planean dos ataques durante la reunión entre el presidente mexicano y el director de la DEA de EE. UU. Luego de una injusta pelea, acusan a Leonor de matar a una prisionera.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica descubre que Aurelio viajará con Lay, y en un ataque de celos, amenaza con matarla. El Cabo busca la ayuda de Robles para viajar a Colombia, y le propone trabajar juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto visita a Ignacio y le pide ayuda para salir del país. Mónica le dispara a Irina para evitar que huya de México. Chema quiere obtener ADN de Aurelio para compararlo con el del cadáver.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto le confiesa a Ximena que se va a Europa para salirse del mundo de la droga. Elsa elige lanzarse como candidata, en lugar de aceptar un puesto en el gabinete presidencial.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor es llevada a juicio, y aunque Ignacio maneja su defensa, la condenan a 15 años. Mientras, Pedro busca el apoyo de Max y Elsa el de Chema durante la campaña para la gubernatura de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio toma al Cabo como rehén y viaja a Colombia, donde toma venganza matando a su hijo. Luego se interna con Mónica en la selva colombiana, él con el nombre de Francisco, ella como Dolores.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio cesa los envíos a Chacorta tras los ataques a las Torres Gemelas, y busca nuevas rutas para pasar la droga. Al campamento llega un infiltrado del Tostado, listo para hacer daño.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leo se debate entre escapar con una compañera de prisión o quedarse y confiar en que Ignacio la libere por vías legales. Mónica le dice a Aurelio que quiere tener un hijo suyo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El general Montoya descubre la verdadera identidad de Francisco, y le pone precio a su silencio. Tras varios años de ausencia, Heriberto regresa a casa y Chacorta lo visita.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema quiere ir a Colombia para descubrir la identidad del mexicano que se está inmiscuyendo en su negocio, y Leonor busca la ayuda del coronel Ramos para liberar a Ponte de la cárcel.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ignacio ofrece casarse con Leonor para que no la deporten. Chacorta le ofrece a Matilde un trato que no puede rechazar. Aurelio amenaza a Gildardo con desmembrarlo si no dice la verdad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Bárbara fue despedida del colegio por arrodillarse cuando sonaba el himno nacional como señal de protesta. Karen tuvo sexo, bajo presión, con su sobrino y lo mató, ahora enfrenta a Daniela.
programme.sub-title: Me arrodillo ante la bandera; Sexo con la tía

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Karina pierde su empleo y a su pareja porque Joel la acusa en las redes de haber abusado de él. Claudia quiere recuperar a su hijo con síndrome de Down, pero el padre se niega a entregarlo.
programme.sub-title: Despertar asqueado; El rey de las redes

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natalia y Luna quieren que su padrastro las adopte, pero su madre prefiere que se queden sin padre. Una joven encuentra a su hermano, quien huyó por miedo y ahora le exige una indemnización.
programme.sub-title: Hijas por amor; Ladrón de documentos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La obsesión de Yadira con el orden y la limpieza la lleva a contagiarse de VIH. El hijo de Cecilia es adicto a los videojuegos violentos y amenaza con cometer una masacre en su colegio.
programme.sub-title: Infección familiar; Juego de la muerte

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Michelle está embarazada de Juan, pero al descubrir que son hermanos, él quiere que aborte, ella se niega por no estar bien de salud. Su pareja muere y ella se adueña de todos los bienes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El padre de José tiene una lesión cerebral severa y hay que operarlo, pero su esposa no da la autorización. Además, Nicole entra en la organización de Blas y termina como esclava sexual.
programme.sub-title: Cirugía o muerte; Marcados como ganado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Chapman ayudó a Juan a salir de la calle, ahora pide que le pague 67 mil dólares por daños y perjuicios. Yuly quiere emanciparse de su mamá y que además corra con sus gastos, porque la espía.
programme.sub-title: Cien años de perdón; Lucha por mi privacidad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Deysi descubre que su esposo es el asesino de su hermano, a quien le sacaron los órganos. Tábata pierde su empleo como taxista porque tenía alergia y su pasajera la acusó de estar drogada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Javier necesita operarse y pide que Zuleika le pague lo que recaudó con un video donde él muestra sus genitales. Carlos dice que las dos hijas de su esposa lo acosan sexualmente y las denuncia.
programme.sub-title: Genitales en YouTube; Mamá bien me lo decía

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniel y Valeria pactaron no tener hijos, ella se embaraza y él la denuncia ante ICE para que la deporten. Félix quiere evitar que Stefany se suicide con su hijo, pero él no sabe la verdad.
programme.sub-title: Marido la vuelve loca; Matando a mis hijos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diambú es un reguetonero en ascenso, pero su esposa pone en riesgo el despegue de su carrera con sus celos. Alma le exige a Jesús que cumpla con el convenio que firmaron para criar a su hija.
programme.sub-title: La vida es de ella; Un hijo producto

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: John le muestra sus partes íntimas a su jefa en una campaña contra el cáncer de testículos, ella queda impactada. Además, una joven casi muere por la obsesión de su hermano con la seguridad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés nunca aceptó la homosexualidad de su hija Valentina. Ella optó por esconderla y salir del país con un supuesto novio. Desde entonces, el padre la ha mantenido, pero ha descubierto que su hija está casada con una mujer y quiere su dinero de vuelta. Michael quiere que su madre, Jessie, entregue a su nieta al sistema porque siente que ella no está apta para cuidarle.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Junior quiere que se reconozca la paternidad del hijo que tiene con Emily. Por otro lado, Marlon fue engañado por Paula, quien le hizo creer que lo amaba y que estaba siendo abusada.
programme.sub-title: Eso no es un papá; Todo por amor

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristian quiere ser el tutor de su madre inhabilitada porque su padre la maltrata. Odette adoptó a Claudia, la niña de su amiga, pero descubrió que en realidad es su verdadera hija.
programme.sub-title: Padre desgraciado; La deuda de la hija adoptiva

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Bárbara quiere la custodia de sus hijas, por eso refina su vocabulario. También, Alicia le tiende una trampa a su esposo en un crucero, él pierde el control y lo detienen, ahora será deportado.
programme.sub-title: Educación brutal; Trampa en el crucero

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El marido de Karla recibe una orden de deportación por culpa de Mirza, quien llamó a la policía porque ellos viven del gobierno. Leonel envía a la cárcel al esposo de Mariposa, su amante.
programme.sub-title: Odio latino; Metió preso a mi marido

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Omar va a Cuba y entrega una casa a cambio de su boda con Lorena, ahora quiere el divorcio. Luisa toma fotografías y videos de mujeres en baños públicos y luego los expone en galerías de arte.
programme.sub-title: De oveja a loba; Baño de mujeres

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Enrique tiene un comportamiento sexual con su nieta, aprovecha cuando la carga en su silla de ruedas. Adriana anda completamente desnuda dentro de su propiedad y Sandor la odia por eso.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana y Darío se enfrentan a una decisión de vida o muerte, la gestación de sus gemelos: uno de ellos tiene problemas cardíacos y su vida corre peligro, pero una intervención quirúrgica podría afectar al otro bebé. Óscar, deseoso de ser un político, se postuló a concejal; pero Yalissa declaró que fue víctima de abusos continuados por parte de Óscar, quien le ofreció plata para que no dijera nada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nora y Daniel tuvieron relaciones, ella estaba borracha y dice que él la violó, pero él argumenta que la confundió con la joven con la que tenía una cita. Tika quiere convertirse en gato.
programme.sub-title: Abusada por error; Quiero ser gato

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quiere vender su casa, pero no obtiene el precio que pide por la influencia de su vecina neonazi. Su hermano pequeño va a un colegio religioso donde el rector es el sacerdote que abusó de él.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carolina se reencuentra con su hija y su esposo, después de tres años, y descubre que la niña vive aislada del mundo. Felicia demanda a su marido por seguir un método japonés para ser feliz.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Juan está convencido de que es una mujer, su esposa, Liscar, le exige que vaya a terapia. Ariana tiene muchas cucarachas en su casa y como su amiga Claudia les tiene miedo, la demanda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alegnis se arrepintió después de haberse sometido a 10 cirugías estéticas para convertirse en la copia de la exesposa de su marido. Carolina causó un accidente mortal con una patineta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Se excita al escuchar a la gente mientras hacen el amor, hasta que fue su esposa quien gritó de placer. Tania está en su auto con un stripper, su esposo la descubre y se produce un accidente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Atropella a un cerdo en la calle y lo cocina, Dayamit dice que era su mascota. Livi escapó con su dote de 60 mil dólares, la madre quiere que la devuelva si no se casa, pero ella ya la usó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Asegura que a su papá lo deportaron por una pelea provocada, pero al parecer el señor es de cuidado. Dice que el amante de su esposa ha sido una bendición, quiere que viva con ellos.
programme.sub-title: Asilo político; Viviendo con el amante

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nelly deja los hábitos, siendo monja, para casarse con Lupita, pero vive un infierno y quiere el divorcio. Enilda demanda a René, durante un incendio él salva los carros y abandona a la abuela.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marco exige 20 mil dólares a Karen por grabar y subir a las redes el ataque homofóbico del que fue víctima su hermana. Rhina pide una indemnización, sus hijos ven pornografía por culpa de Rubí.
programme.sub-title: Intolerancia gay; Pervirtiendo a mis niños

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Néstor es un transexual que habla y se viste como la Dra. Polo. Además, Osni y Edith, quienes compran "storages" y venden los productos que encuentran, discuten por un radio viejo con una nota.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Isidro maneja sus finanzas solo con dinero en efectivo y al perder sus ahorros, demanda a su pareja. Mercedes enseña ciencias con experimentos prácticos, una estudiante se quema con hielo.
programme.sub-title: El regalo de Santa; Experimento en clases

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonio le exige a su ex, quien lo golpeó en los genitales, que pague los gastos médicos. Gabo quiere anular la paternidad del hijo que tiene con Valery, porque no lo concibió conscientemente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Zamira padece glaucoma y su esposo quiere que reciba atención médica, ella pide un tratamiento natural. Karina quiere el divorcio de Luz, cree que su saliva es sanadora y cura con la lengua.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mónica le pide a Verónica, su ex, el dinero que le dio para invertir en su negocio, hay intereses ocultos. Alberto despierta del coma y no recuerda su boda con un transexual, quiere anularla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alfonso demanda a su esposa, ella se cree productora y quiere que los hijos sean grandes artistas. Exige orden de alejamiento contra la dueña de un restaurante donde dejó una mala opinión.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pedro quiere internar a su hermano en el manicomio por poner su vida en peligro para ganar un premio Darwin. Raquel pide el divorcio, su esposo enfrentará a su amante en un duelo medieval.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniel come un pez globo, muy venenoso y cae en coma, ahora demanda al restaurante donde lo consumió. Ambas son cantantes, pero Aylinne usa su trabajo para traficar droga, y acusan a Bella.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tony demanda a Carlos porque la esposa da a luz, inesperadamente, dentro de su food truck y causó daños. Fabio exige que su ex le dé 20 mil dólares, porque el bebé no es su hijo, sino su nieto.
programme.sub-title: Un nacimiento imprevisto; Persona de interés

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Claudia es evangélica y Jorge es amish, él quiere la custodia de su hijo para llevárselo. Jay Mula es un dominicano que rapea en inglés sin mucho éxito, pero se niega a cantar en español.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tebelio desaparece al viajar en balsa hacia Estados Unidos, lo dan por muerto, pero está vivo. Antonio le compra a María unas tierras en Colombia que resultaron ser de un capo de la droga.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Misael exige que Loreta le pague por haber matado a la serpiente que tenía como mascota. Susan es una maestra con novedosos métodos, la expulsan y pide que la escuela le pague lo que le debe.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Anabel exige compensación por desempleo, su jefe la despidió por negarse a trabajar con una prótesis que remarca su vagina. Brenda quiere que su hija se divorcie y el desalojo de su yerno.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Maira anuncia en Internet que al cumplir 18 años tendrá sexo en vivo con su papá, la madre se opone. Ana manda a buscar a sus hijos en la frontera, pero los niños están a cargo de ICE.
programme.sub-title: Vendiendo el incesto; Cuarenta días de angustia

programme.desc: Mariela quiere recuperar la custodia de su hija, pero Criss, el padre de la niña, se niega. Por otro lado, Mabel conoce a un chico haitiano con una historia de vida complicada, él la engaña.

A cranio-facial surgeon and a skeptic provide us with their perspectives on this very strange relic.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: What can lead a military man to draw his service weapon in his own base, and completely unload the magazine of his rifle? In the cases that we are going to analyze, these military men claim to have witnessed the appearance of strange humanoid beings.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: Explore mysterious sightings spanning millennia, from ancient rock art to recent encounters. Witness strange lights over Barranco de Badajoz and a peculiar being at 'El Condesito' farm in Huelva. Encounter enigmatic humanoids on Conil beaches. Hear from witnesses to unravel the uncanny connection between past depictions and present sightings.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: An extraterrestrial threat. A top secret organization. Has the US made contact with aliens? Experts believe they have. And an ultra top secret organization is calling all the shots. Get ready for the untold story of Majestic 12.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Many UFO sightings are solitary events that leave witnesses scrambling to prove their story. But what happens when the same object is seen by many people at the same time? Join us as we expose the hidden secrets of The Kecksburg Incident.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: More than half the world's UFO sightings happen over water. Many of these phenomena are seen bursting from the ocean into the sky. Do aliens lurk in our oceans? Join us as we expose the growing threat of Unidentified Submerged Objects.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: What does the American government really know about UFO's? And how far will they go to hide the truth? In 1948 a fireball crashes near Laredo, Texas. They say it was an experimental aircraft. But many experts believe it was a UFO.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The end is near. There have been signs and prophecies for centuries but it does feel like man's time on this planet is almost over. The question is: are you ready for Doomsday?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: There is a secret government facility accused of creating many diseases currently plaguing our country. Have we unleashed these biological weapons on purpose and if so, is there a secret lab near you?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Several US presidents throughout history have described encounters with UAPs. Is there already an agreement in place between our world leaders and intelligent alien life? And if so, who is keeping that information from the public and why?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight? And in 2017 scientists discovered another mysterious satellite from outside our solar system. What could explain Oumuamua's artificial trajectory?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Mars is the key focus of humanity's expansion into space right now. Millions of years ago the Red Planet had a lot in common with Earth, but it's now a desert wasteland. Do the doorways recently discovered on the planet's surface lead to an existential lesson for our species?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files

programme.desc: Out of the Badlands, a wasteland so desolate that nothing is known to take root, come three terrifying stories: the 'Devil's Highway', menacing Black Eyed Kids, and the Curse of Superstition Mountain.

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Florida's Skunk Ape stalks and attacks a hunter in the swamp, evidence of the Lizard Man of Scape Ore Swamp is revealed, and a teenage boy in South Carolina survives an extraordinary alien abudction and lives to tell his story.
programme.sub-title: Skunk Ape, Pascagoula Aliens, Lizard Man

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries

programme.sub-title: UFO Bigfoot, Lake Pepin Monster, Cajun Werewolf

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: It is likely that aliens exist in a universe as large as ours. How would they navigate those vast distances and potentially visit us on earth?
